title: Base-change target coordinates and the constant-coefficient restriction square
statement: Let k and K be fields with a k-algebra structure on K, let I be a finite type, let f:C -> Spec k, and let D_i be schemes with structure morphisms g_i and coprojections iota_i:D_i -> C whose composites with f equal g_i. Suppose C with the iota_i is a coproduct [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. For n,q natural numbers use the constant Z/n sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and canonical cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Write p:C_K -> C and p_i:(D_i)_K -> D_i for the first projections. There is an equivalence eK from H^q(C_K,p^*Z/n_C) to the product of H^q((D_i)_K,p_i^*Z/n_D_i). For each x and i, the i-coordinate of eK(p^*x) equals p_i^* of the normalized restriction of x along iota_i, where normalization is Sheaf.H.map of the canonical inverse-image constant-sheaf isomorphism. No comparison bijectivity, smoothness, connectedness, algebraic closure or invertibility is assumed; n=0, n=1, q=0 and an empty index type are included.

source.place: First step: finite clopen component reduction; Base-change target coordinates and the constant-coefficient restriction square

proof.text: The coprojections are clopen immersions with disjoint images covering C. Base change pulls back those images to a disjoint clopen cover of C_K by (D_i)_K. Apply the scheme coproduct universal property to this cover, identifying the component maps using iota_i followed by f = g_i. This includes the empty coproduct.

Apply finiteCoproductCohomologyAssembly on C_K to the coefficient sheaf p^*Z/n_C. The pullback squares and upperStarComp identify its inverse images on (D_i)_K with p_i^*Z/n_D_i after the constant-sheaf restriction isomorphism. Compose each coordinate with the equivalence induced on H by that sheaf isomorphism, obtaining eK.

Use cohomologyPullbackFunctorial on the two paths around each square. Naturality in the sheaf and constantPullbackCompositionCoherence identify the resulting coefficient isomorphisms with the chosen inverse-image constant-sheaf comparison. Thus the i-coordinate of eK applied to p^*x is p_i^* applied to H.map of the constant-sheaf comparison on iota_i^*x, exactly the formula in Lean. This is an identity of maps and asserts no bijectivity of p^* or p_i^*.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoproductConstantBaseChangeSquare
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] {C : Scheme.{u}} (D : I → Scheme.{u})
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g : ∀ i, D i ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (ι : ∀ i, D i ⟶ C) (hw : ∀ i, ι i ≫ f = g i)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk C ι)) (n q : ℕ) :
    ∃ eK : Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj
          (C.constantZMod n)) q ≃
      ∀ i, Sheaf.H
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.fst (g i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj
            ((D i).constantZMod n)) q,
    ∀ (x : Sheaf.H (C.constantZMod n) q) (i : I),
      eK (cohomologyMap
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
        (C.constantZMod n) q x) i =
      cohomologyMap
        (pullback.fst (g i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
        ((D i).constantZMod n) q
        (Sheaf.H.map
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (ι i)).hom.app
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))) q
          (cohomologyMap (ι i) (C.constantZMod n) q x))
